create.name: Megha Nancy Buttenheim
create.bio:
Megha Nancy Buttenheim is a dancer, singer, actor and yoga teacher-trainer based in Pittsfield, Massachusetts, in the Berkshires. She has taught at Kripalu since 1985, where she spent years directing its yoga teacher training and its holistic health training, and she now belongs to its legacy faculty. She is also the founding director of Let Your Yoga Dance, a joyful practice that she has been training instructors in since 1997, and she helped create Embodied Positive Psychology with the Wholebeing Institute.

Let Your Yoga Dance blends yoga, dance, breath and qigong with the chakra system, using music chosen for each energy centre and moving from dance prayer through to meditation and relaxation. Megha teaches regular live classes on Zoom, including a gentle yoga and qigong class, runs teacher trainings at her home studio, at Kripalu and online, and has led workshops across North America, England, Australia and Costa Rica. Her book Expanding Joy brings her practice and positive psychology together, with short movement exercises woven through the chapters, and she has made recorded practices such as a thirty-day movement series built on personal strengths.

books.title: Expanding Joy: Let Your Yoga Dance, Embodying Positive Psychology
books.author: Megha Nancy Buttenheim
books.description: Megha's book on her dancing yoga practice, joining it with ideas from positive psychology. Short movement exercises run through the text, and readers can download matching videos.

courses.title: Let Your Yoga Dance Online Class
courses.description: A one-hour live class on Zoom in which Megha leads the group in dancing through the chakras, mixing yoga movement, music and prayerful dance.

courses.title: Gentle Yoga-QiGong Online Class
courses.description: A one-hour live class on Zoom combining gentle yoga with qigong movement, taught by Megha as a calm, unhurried practice.

courses.title: Let Your Yoga Dance Teacher Training
courses.description: Megha's certification training for those who want to lead Let Your Yoga Dance classes, covering the chakra system, music for each centre, yogic ethics and practice teaching. Open to all levels.

courses.title: Moving With Your Strengths: A 30 Day Practice for Every Body! - Videos
courses.description: A set of short recorded movement sequences, one for each day of a month, each built around a personal character strength. Designed for any body and any level.
